{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for seeking a negotiated change in the Anti-Ballistic Missile (ABM) Treaty that will allow the United States to use all technologies and experiments required to deploy robust missile defenses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans believe the administration should not negotiate inadequate modifications to the ABM Treaty that would leave the United States with a flawed agreement that ties the hands of the next president and prevents America from defending itself.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States must be able to select the systems that will work best, not those that answer political expediency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for aggressively reinvigorating the ballistic missile defense technology base necessary to ensure the success of these systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There are today more positive, practical ways to reassure Russia that missile defenses are a search for common security, not for unilateral advantage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Russia refuses to make the necessary changes, a Republican president will give prompt notice that the United States will exercise the right guaranteed to it in the treaty to withdraw after six months.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The president has a solemn obligation to protect the American people and allies, not to protect arms control agreements signed almost 30 years ago.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
